title: Sovereign Tower review
summary: Judiciously rule a fantasy kingdom, or just use time travel to fix all of your terrible mistakes.
body: Need to know What is it? A visual novel, RPG, management game with time travel. Release date August 6, 2026 Expect to pay $17/£12.74 Developer Wild Wit Games Publisher Curve Games Reviewed on RTX 4090, Intel i9-13900k, 32GB RAM Steam Deck Verified Link Steam Sovereign Tower is so much more than it seems—which feels rather appropriate for a game where you play an itinerant leper who accidentally becomes the ruler of a magical kingdom, the titular Sovereign. Nobody is quite sure what to make of you, especially if, like me, you start suggesting eating cats or recruit a literal wolf to join your Knights of the Roundtable. At first glance this is a cosy visual novel management game with a soft colour palette and handsome art. You sit on your throne listening to requests, demands and grievances, and then you send out your growing gaggle of knights on quests in an attempt to keep everyone happy. But Sovereign Tower quickly reveals itself to be a complicated juggling act where nearly everyone needs your help, and those who don't probably want to kill you.
